answer_1.quote: Experiments conducted on ASR, speech translation (ST), speech-language understanding (SLU), and question answering (QA) demonstrate that our method, even when applied solely to ASR datasets, effectively improves LSM performance across diverse tasks...
answer_1.outputs: The model generates text responses based on speech inputs and textual instructions, including translated text, extracted keywords, recognized intents, sentiment labels, and answers to questions.

answer_2.quote: For ASR, we evaluated the model using the LibriSpeech test-clean and test-other sets, adopting word error rate (WER) as the performance metric... employing the SacreBLEU score (Post, 2018) as the evaluation... Accuracy (ACC) served as the metric for both KE and IC tasks... For the WebQA dataset, BertScore (Zhang et al., 2019) was used as the evaluation metric, and for BoolQA, ACC was used as the evaluation metric.
